useWhen: Running the itonami-maint maturity iteration against the sim-loop status ledger
avoidWhen: Editing the ledger outside the runbook's harness (self-matching greps and empty stdout are known traps)

inputs.ledger: sim-loop/status/maturity.md + evidence/ in the maint worktree

outputs.iteration: one maturity iteration with redirected-output evidence

authority.binding: caller authorization; writes only to the caller-authorized worktree

validation.runtime: runbook measured in itonami-maint cron iterations (falsify-56 findings); home paths normalized to ~; registry install path not tested

compatibilityNote: Hermes skill shape only; home paths in the body are normalized to ~. Wildcard versions express no runtime compatibility.
